 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Yan Diomande has the chance to make history in Real Madrid's rivalry with Barcelona, with the young forward potentially becoming the second youngest player to score for Los Blancos in El Clasico.
 If he finds the net against the Blaugrana , he would enter a select group of Madrid players, at 19 years and 346 days old, who have scored against their fiercest rivals before turning 20.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The milestone would place Diomande just behind Vinicius Jr., whose early impact in the fixture sets the benchmark for the teenager.
 Vinicius Jr. holds the Real Madrid record
 According to statistics published by OptaJose, Vinicius remains the youngest Real Madrid player to score in El Clasico, having done so at 19 years and 233 days old.
 Diomande would be 113 days older than the Brazilian when reaching the potential milestone, leaving him second on the historical list if he scores.
 While the record would not surpass Vinicius's achievement, it would show the club's record signing's ability to deliver in a fixture where performances are often remembered long after the final whistle.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement El Clasico offers Diomande a chance to make his mark
 Vinicius's record illustrates how a young player can use a meeting with Barcelona to announce himself on the biggest stage.
 The Brazilian has since become a central figure in Real Madrid's attack, although he will miss tonight's fixture through suspension.
 Yan Diomande is on the verge of achieving an El Clasico record. (Photo by Mateo Villalba Sanchez/Getty Images)
 For Diomande, scoring against Barcelona would offer an opportunity to make a similarly memorable impression.
 A potential milestone in a defining fixture
 El Clasico goals carry particular weight because of the rivalry's history, but scoring before the age of 20 would give Diomande's achievement additional significance.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As such, joining Vinicius among Real Madrid's youngest goalscorers against Barcelona would provide an early landmark in his career.
 The statistic alone would not place Diomande on the same trajectory as the Brazilian, but taking advantage of this opportunity could give the young forward a memorable moment in a fixture that can influence reputations.
